Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Port and industrial land rather than a neighbourhood: CBS records only 140 residents in the whole wijk. There is no housing to assess and nobody stays here — what is inside the boundary is terminals, tanks and rail. It is on the map because it is one of Rotterdam's official wijken, and the honest rating for an empty refinery is that nothing here concerns a traveller, not a safety judgement dressed up as one.

Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.
